title: Dragon's Projectile Fix
description: Fixes small projectile desyncs and rendering bugs
body:
## **Dragon's Projectile fix**

This client side 1.21.11 mod fixes projectile desyncs. Support is limited to the current version only.

### This mod has the following features:
- Projectile fixes that make the projectile path more smooth.
- A config menu to disable or enable certain features.
- mod **Modmenu**, mod **Dragon's Armor Hud** support.
